passiveAbility.name: Many Roads
passiveAbility.description: Lowlanders settle wherever trade and farmland meet, and take on the habits of every neighbour they meet. Their adaptable, restless nature leaves them at home in almost any trade.

passiveAbility.name: Stoneborn
passiveAbility.description: Delvers raise their halls inside the mountains and measure kinship in generations of unbroken craft. They are stubborn and exacting, and trust what is built to last.

passiveAbility.name: Hearth and Home
passiveAbility.description: Hearthkin are small folk who prize a full table, a warm fire and a quiet life. Their cheer hides a nimble, practical streak that surprises anyone who mistakes comfort for softness.

passiveAbility.name: Old Blood
passiveAbility.description: The Veyl are a long-lived people of the deep forests, shaped by memories that outlast kingdoms. They are graceful and aloof, and slow to share what they know.
